# Dart documentation

> Dart is an approachable, portable, and productive language for building high-quality apps on any platform.

Dart is open source and features sound null safety, a strong static type system with type inference, ahead-of-time native and WebAssembly compilation alongside fast JIT development, and first-class integration with Flutter.

This index provides a curated list of official documentation and resources covering the Dart language, core libraries, package ecosystem, interoperability tools, and SDK workflows.

## Getting started

- [Dart documentation](https://dart.dev/docs.md): Main entry point for official Dart guides, tutorials, and reference documentation.
- [Dart overview](https://dart.dev/overview.md): Introduction to the Dart language, core libraries, native and web platforms, and runtime.
- [Get the Dart SDK](https://dart.dev/get-dart.md): Install and update the standalone Dart SDK on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Learn Dart](https://dart.dev/learn.md): Learning paths for Dart and Flutter, starting with a hands-on Dart tutorial.
- [Dart tutorial](https://dart.dev/learn/tutorial): Build a command-line app that fetches and parses JSON, handles errors, and has automated tests.
- [Dart cheatsheet](https://dart.dev/resources/dart-cheatsheet.md): Examples and exercises for Dart syntax, null-aware operators, string interpolation, cascades, and initializers.

## Latest release

- [Announcing Dart 3.14](https://dart.dev/blog/announcing-dart-3-14.md): Official announcement for Dart 3.14 covering `dart migrate`, WebAssembly SIMD and exceptions, re-engineered DartPad, and stable native interop generators.
- [Dart changelog](https://dart.dev/changelog.md): Release-by-release summary of new features, fixes, deprecations, and breaking changes across the Dart SDK.
- [What's new in the docs](https://dart.dev/resources/whats-new.md): Recent additions and updates across `dart.dev` documentation and guides.
- [Breaking changes](https://dart.dev/resources/breaking-changes.md): Breaking changes and migration guidance across Dart SDK releases.
- [What's new in Flutter 3.50](https://flutter.dev/blog/whats-new-in-flutter-3-50): Companion release announcement for the paired Flutter 3.50 SDK release.

## Dart language

- [Introduction to Dart](https://dart.dev/language.md): Tour of core Dart syntax, concepts, and program structure.
- [Variables](https://dart.dev/language/variables.md): Variable declarations, null safety defaults, `late`, `final`, and `const`.
- [Operators](https://dart.dev/language/operators.md): Operator precedence, arithmetic, comparisons, type tests, null-aware operators, and cascades.
- [Built-in types](https://dart.dev/language/built-in-types.md): Numbers, strings, booleans, runes, and symbols in Dart.
- [Records](https://dart.dev/language/records.md): Anonymous, immutable aggregate types for bundling multiple values and returning multiple results.
- [Collections](https://dart.dev/language/collections.md): Lists, sets, maps, collection `if` and `for` control-flow elements, and null-aware elements.
- [Generics](https://dart.dev/language/generics.md): Parameterized types, bounded type parameters, and reified generic runtime behavior.
- [Typedefs](https://dart.dev/language/typedefs.md): Type aliases declared with `typedef`, including generic and function type aliases.
- [The Dart type system](https://dart.dev/language/type-system.md): Sound static type checking, type inference, and runtime guarantees.
- [Patterns](https://dart.dev/language/patterns.md): Destructuring values and matching shapes in variable declarations, `switch` expressions, and control flow.
- [Pattern types](https://dart.dev/language/pattern-types.md): Reference for every pattern kind, precedence rule, and matching behavior in Dart.
- [Branches](https://dart.dev/language/branches.md): Conditional control flow with `if`, `if-case`, and exhaustive `switch` statements and expressions.
- [Loops](https://dart.dev/language/loops.md): Iteration with `for`, `for-in`, `while`, `do-while`, `break`, and `continue`.
- [Functions](https://dart.dev/language/functions.md): Positional and named parameters, first-class functions, closures, tear-offs, and generators.
- [Metadata](https://dart.dev/language/metadata.md): Built-in, analyzer-supported, and custom annotations for declarations.
- [Libraries and imports](https://dart.dev/language/libraries.md): Imports, prefixes, library privacy, and deferred loading.
- [Error handling](https://dart.dev/language/error-handling.md): Throwing, catching, and rethrowing exceptions, `try`/`on`/`catch`/`finally`, and `assert`.
- [Classes](https://dart.dev/language/classes.md): Class instances, instance variables, implicit interfaces, and static members.
- [Constructors](https://dart.dev/language/constructors.md): Generative, named, redirecting, `const`, and `factory` constructors.
- [Primary constructors](https://dart.dev/language/primary-constructors.md): Concise class header syntax for declaring constructors and initializing fields together.
- [Methods](https://dart.dev/language/methods.md): Instance methods, getters, setters, operator overloads, and abstract methods.
- [Extend a class](https://dart.dev/language/extend.md): Inheritance with `extends`, member overrides, `super`, and `noSuchMethod()`.
- [Enums](https://dart.dev/language/enums.md): Declaring fixed sets of values and adding fields, methods, and constructors to enhanced enums.
- [Dot shorthands](https://dart.dev/language/dot-shorthands.md): Concise `.member` syntax for static members, constructors, and enum values when context provides the type.
- [Extension methods](https://dart.dev/language/extension-methods.md): Adding helper methods, getters, and operators to existing types without wrapper classes.
- [Extension types](https://dart.dev/language/extension-types.md): Zero-cost compile-time wrappers for static interfaces and foreign-language interop bindings.
- [Mixins](https://dart.dev/language/mixins.md): Reusing member implementations across multiple class hierarchies with `mixin` and `on` constraints.
- [Class modifiers](https://dart.dev/language/class-modifiers.md): Controlling subtyping and exhaustiveness across library boundaries with `abstract`, `base`, `interface`, `final`, `sealed`, and `mixin`.
- [Sound null safety](https://dart.dev/null-safety.md): Introduction to nullable and non-nullable types, initialization, and how Dart detects unsafe uses of `null`.
- [Language versioning](https://dart.dev/language/versioning.md): How the SDK constraint sets a package's default language version, per-library version overrides, and language-versioned changes.

## Core libraries

- [Core libraries overview](https://dart.dev/libraries.md): Guide to the foundational libraries shipped with the Dart SDK.
- [dart:core](https://dart.dev/libraries/dart-core.md): Numbers, collections, strings, `Uri`, `DateTime`, `RegExp`, and core object APIs.
- [dart:async](https://dart.dev/libraries/dart-async.md): `Future` and `Stream` APIs for asynchronous programming.
- [dart:convert](https://dart.dev/libraries/dart-convert.md): Encoders and decoders for JSON, UTF-8, and custom data formats.
- [dart:io](https://dart.dev/libraries/dart-io.md): Files, directories, sockets, HTTP clients and servers, and processes for native and server runtimes.
- [dart:math](https://dart.dev/libraries/dart-math.md): Mathematical constants, trigonometry, logarithms, and random number generators.
- [Iterable collections](https://dart.dev/libraries/collections/iterables.md): Iteration, searching, filtering, and mapping with `Iterable` collections.
- [Using JSON](https://dart.dev/libraries/serialization/json.md): Libraries and resources for JSON serialization, including `dart:convert`, `json_serializable`, and `built_value`.
- [Dart API reference](https://api.dart.dev/): API documentation for the Dart SDK libraries.

## Asynchronous programming and concurrency

- [Concurrency in Dart](https://dart.dev/language/concurrency.md): Overview of the Dart event loop, `async`/`await`, and parallel execution with isolates.
- [Asynchronous programming](https://dart.dev/language/async.md): Language support for futures and streams with `async`, `await`, and `await for`.
- [Asynchronous programming: futures, async, await](https://dart.dev/libraries/async/async-await.md): Practical tutorial on writing non-blocking Dart code with `Future`, `async`, and `await`.
- [Using streams](https://dart.dev/libraries/async/using-streams.md): Processing sequences of asynchronous events with `await for` and `Stream` combinators.
- [Creating streams](https://dart.dev/libraries/async/creating-streams.md): Producing streams with `async*` generator functions and `StreamController`.
- [Isolates](https://dart.dev/language/isolates.md): Running CPU-intensive work in parallel across isolated memory heaps with `Isolate.run` and ports.

## Native and JavaScript interoperability

- [Interoperability overview](https://dart.dev/interop.md): Guide to calling C, Objective-C, Swift, Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript code from Dart.
- [C interop using dart:ffi](https://dart.dev/interop/c-interop.md): Calling native C APIs directly with `dart:ffi` and generating bindings with `package:ffigen`.
- [Objective-C and Swift interop](https://dart.dev/interop/objective-c-interop.md): Generating Dart bindings for Apple Objective-C and `@objc` Swift APIs using `package:ffigen`.
- [Java and Kotlin interop](https://dart.dev/interop/java-interop.md): Generating Dart bindings for Java and Kotlin libraries on Android and JVM platforms using `package:jnigen`.
- [Hooks](https://dart.dev/tools/hooks.md): Compiling and bundling native code assets automatically during package builds with `hook/build.dart`.
- [JavaScript interop overview](https://dart.dev/interop/js-interop.md): Static, Wasm-compatible interoperability with browser and JavaScript APIs using `dart:js_interop`.
- [JS interop usage](https://dart.dev/interop/js-interop/usage.md): Interop types, `external` members, `@JS()` annotations, object literal constructors, and exporting Dart functions to JavaScript.
- [JS types](https://dart.dev/interop/js-interop/js-types.md): Reference for `JSAny`, `JSObject`, `JSArray`, `JSPromise`, `JSIterable`, primitive conversions, and runtime type checks.
- [Web interop with package:web](https://dart.dev/interop/js-interop/package-web.md): Accessing browser DOM and Web APIs with `package:web` across JavaScript and WebAssembly targets.

## Packages, pub, and workspaces

- [How to use packages](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/packages.md): Adding, importing, and upgrading dependencies from `pub.dev` in Dart projects.
- [dart pub](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/cmd.md): Reference for `dart pub` subcommands that manage dependencies, run command-line apps, and publish packages.
- [Creating packages](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/create-packages.md): Structuring, documenting, and designing reusable Dart library packages.
- [Package layout conventions](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/package-layout.md): Standard directory structure for public libraries, implementation files, tests, examples, hooks, and skills.
- [The pubspec file](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/pubspec.md): Reference for `pubspec.yaml` fields, SDK constraints, dependencies, platforms, and topics.
- [Package dependencies](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/dependencies.md): Hosted, Git, path, and SDK dependency syntax, version constraints, and overrides.
- [Pub workspaces](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/workspaces.md): Managing monorepos with shared dependency resolution and a single `pubspec.lock`.
- [Publishing packages](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/publishing.md): Preparing, validating, and publishing packages to `pub.dev`, including automated GitHub Actions publishing.
- [Data-driven fixes](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/data-driven-fixes.md): Authoring `fix_data.yaml` rules so consumers can migrate across breaking package API changes with `dart fix`.
- [Distributing CLI tools](https://dart.dev/tools/cli-distribution.md): Packaging and distributing Dart command-line executables for developers and end users.
- [Commonly used packages](https://dart.dev/resources/useful-packages.md): Popular general-purpose and specialized packages, including packages that expand on the Dart core libraries.
- [pub.dev package repository](https://pub.dev/): Official package repository for Dart and Flutter libraries and tools.

## Build with AI

- [Build with AI overview](https://dart.dev/ai.md): Tools for building AI-powered Dart apps and connecting coding agents to Dart tooling and documentation.
- [Package skills](https://dart.dev/ai/package-skills.md): Discovering, installing, and managing AI coding agent skills distributed by Dart and Flutter packages.
- [package:skills CLI](https://dart.dev/tools/package-skills.md): Command-line reference for running `dart run skills@` to install and maintain agent skills.
- [Ship skills with packages](https://dart.dev/tools/pub/package-skills.md): Authoring, structuring, linting with `package:skills_lint`, and publishing agent skills inside `pub.dev` packages.
- [Dart and Flutter MCP server](https://docs.flutter.dev/ai/tools.md#dart-and-flutter-mcp-server): Connecting AI coding assistants to live analyzer diagnostics, pub search, formatting, fixes, and test execution.
- [Developer Knowledge MCP server](https://developers.google.com/knowledge/mcp.md.txt): Giving AI coding agents live search access to official `dart.dev`, `docs.flutter.dev`, and Google developer documentation.
- [Genkit for Dart](https://genkit.dev/docs/dart/get-started.md): Get started with Genkit in a Dart backend and connect it to a client app.

## Static analysis, testing, and SDK tools

- [Dart tools overview](https://dart.dev/tools.md): Overview of IDE plugins, SDK CLI commands, static analysis, and debugging tools.
- [Customizing static analysis](https://dart.dev/tools/analysis.md): Configuring `analysis_options.yaml`, enabling lint sets, excluding files, and adjusting diagnostic severities.
- [Diagnostic messages](https://dart.dev/tools/diagnostics): Reference catalog of Dart analyzer diagnostics with explanations and fixes.
- [Linter rules](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules): Searchable catalog of Dart analyzer lint rules organized by rule set and status.
- [All linter rules](https://dart.dev/tools/linter-rules/all.md): Generated `analysis_options.yaml` snippet listing stable, released Dart lint rules.
- [Fixing type promotion failures](https://dart.dev/tools/non-promotion-reasons.md): Understanding why nullable fields or variables fail to promote and how to refactor them cleanly.
- [dart command-line tool](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-tool.md): Unified CLI entry point for creating, analyzing, formatting, running, testing, migrating, and compiling Dart code.
- [dart analyze](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-analyze.md): Running static analysis from the command line and CI pipelines.
- [dart fix](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-fix.md): Applying automated lint cleanups and package API migrations across a Dart project.
- [dart format](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-format.md): Formatting Dart source code idiomatically with configurable style options.
- [dart migrate](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-migrate.md): Automating Dart SDK version constraint upgrades, lint adoption, and code migrations.
- [dart compile](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-compile.md): Compiling Dart programs to self-contained native executables, AOT snapshots, JavaScript, and WebAssembly.
- [dart build](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-build.md): Building CLI applications and bundling native code assets configured by build hooks.
- [Testing Dart apps](https://dart.dev/tools/testing.md): Writing and running unit, asynchronous, and platform-targeted tests with `package:test` and `dart test`.
- [build_runner](https://dart.dev/tools/build_runner.md): Running code generation for serialization, mocks, database schemas, and web builds.
- [Dart DevTools](https://dart.dev/tools/dart-devtools.md): Profiling CPU, memory, network activity, and performance in Dart and Flutter applications.

## Command-line, server, and web apps

- [Command-line and server apps](https://dart.dev/server.md): Building CLI utilities, HTTP servers, and backend services with Dart.
- [Server libraries and packages](https://dart.dev/server/libraries.md): Recommended packages for routing (`shelf`), gRPC, databases, and backend workflows.
- [Google Cloud with Dart](https://dart.dev/server/google-cloud.md): Running containerized Dart servers on Cloud Run and integrating Google Cloud services.
- [Web apps overview](https://dart.dev/web.md): Building browser applications with Dart compiled to WebAssembly (`dart2wasm`) and JavaScript (`dart2js`).
- [WebAssembly compilation](https://dart.dev/web/wasm.md): Compiling Dart web apps and standalone modules to WebAssembly, including WasmGC, SIMD, and browser requirements.
- [Web deployment](https://dart.dev/web/deployment.md): Optimizing, serving, and securing production Dart web builds.
- [Debugging web apps](https://dart.dev/web/debugging.md): Testing and debugging Dart web applications across modern browsers.
- [Multiplatform apps](https://dart.dev/multiplatform-apps.md): Building native mobile, desktop, and web user interfaces in Dart with Flutter.

## Effective Dart and resources

- [Effective Dart](https://dart.dev/effective-dart.md): Official Dart guidelines for consistent, idiomatic, maintainable code.
- [Effective Dart: Style](https://dart.dev/effective-dart/style.md): Naming conventions, import ordering, and formatting rules.
- [Effective Dart: Documentation](https://dart.dev/effective-dart/documentation.md): Writing clear `///` doc comments, prose summaries, and Markdown code references.
- [Effective Dart: Usage](https://dart.dev/effective-dart/usage.md): Idiomatic usage of collections, null safety, async APIs, and members.
- [Effective Dart: Design](https://dart.dev/effective-dart/design.md): Designing clean, evolvable Dart APIs, classes, parameters, and types.
- [Dart language evolution](https://dart.dev/resources/language/evolution.md): Version-by-version history of language features added across Dart releases.
- [Dart language specification](https://dart.dev/resources/language/spec.md): Formal specification and feature specifications for the Dart language.
- [Glossary](https://dart.dev/resources/glossary): Definitions of core Dart language, runtime, and tooling terms.
- [Security](https://dart.dev/security.md): Reporting vulnerabilities, reviewing security advisories, and following Dart security practices.
- [Dart blog](https://dart.dev/blog): Release announcements, engineering deep dives, and ecosystem updates from the Dart team.
